title: 第三章 租房第四章 日记第五章 四楼
content_zh:
依旧是那个空间。
那个女性的声音依旧继续响起。
“你死了。”
“死于房东太太手下。”
“你死的毫无价值。”
“你没挖掘出任何侵蚀点，也未对剧情做出任何推动，所以这次死亡无法得到任何奖励。”
然而周游并没有搭理那个声音，他呆滞地看着前方，似乎仍然没从死亡的惊恐中解脱出来。
但下一秒。
他却忽地咧开了嘴。
然后，突兀地笑了起来。
——死的毫无价值？
开什么玩笑！
这次死亡的收获比之前多太多了好不！
——最起码，现在有通关的头绪了！
半晌，笑声哑止，而周游也毫不犹豫地再次选择了进入。
依旧是那个楼道，这回周游毫不犹豫地向着二楼走去，但这一次他并没有敲任何门，而是直接站在那里，仰头直视三楼的走廊，默默地等待。
——之前那个租客哀嚎出其中一个信息。
“遵守规矩，不要去打扰别的住户。”
大约三四分钟后，一阵脚步声忽然响起。
那脚步声十分的怪异，并没有普通人鞋底接触地面时的踢踏声，而只有像是节拍一样，短暂而又急促的敲击。

......那感觉就仿佛正在行走的不是人类的双脚，而是两根干枯的木棍。
很快，一张皱巴巴的脸从黑洞洞的楼道中探了出来。
只是这回没等对方有什么动作，周游便先行迎了上去。
他的脸上没有任何的惊慌和恐惧，有的只有温暖如太阳般的笑意。
“你好，我是新来的租客，请问你是房东太太吗？”
如死木般的老人没做任何回应。
它用那惨白的眼珠打量了周游好半天，却始终无法看清，于是它抬起手，按住自己的脸。
接着，这位居然硬生生地扣出了一颗眼珠，放到满是污渍的衣服中，仔细擦了擦。
一只肥硕的蛆虫从眼眶间探出，它摆动着躯体，似乎想要找到些食物，但马上就被‘房东太太’给按了回去。
看着这副怪异而又惊悚的景色，周游的笑容却是一如既往的灿烂。
——之前那个租客哀嚎出第二个信息。
“要礼貌。”
半天之后，‘房东太太’似乎终于擦干净了眼球，又将其塞了进去，接着张开黑洞洞的嘴，用嘶哑，仿佛锯木般的声音说道。
“新来的住户是吧，带钱了吗？”
周游想起剧本开始时的介绍，急匆匆地在身上摸索了一阵，果不其然地，在上衣的口袋里摸索到了整整一沓的钱。
但在拿出之前，他稍微迟疑了下，接着不着痕迹地分出了一半，接着才将其余的递了过去。
老太太那脸上终于浮现出一丝笑容，那枯槁的嘴缓缓张开——
这回并没扩大，其中也没有森森利齿。
然而某人仍然感觉胃里一阵涌动。
content_en:
It’s still that space.
The female voice still continued to sound.
"You're dead."
"Death at the hands of the landlady."
"You died worthless."
"You didn't excavate any erosion points, and you didn't advance the plot in any way, so you can't get any rewards for this death."
However, Zhou You didn't pay attention to the voice. He stared blankly ahead, as if he still wasn't freed from the fear of death.
But the next second.
He suddenly grinned.
Then he laughed suddenly.
——Death is worthless?
What a joke!
The harvest from death this time is much greater than before, okay!
——At least, now I have a clue to clear the level!
After a while, the laughter stopped, and Zhou You chose to enter again without hesitation.
It was still the same corridor, this time Zhou You walked towards the second floor without hesitation, but this time he didn't knock on any door, but just stood there, looking up at the corridor on the third floor, waiting silently.
——The previous tenant wailed one of the messages.
"Follow the rules and don't disturb other residents."
About three or four minutes later, a sound of footsteps suddenly sounded.
The footsteps were very weird. There was no tapping sound like when ordinary people's soles hit the ground, but only a short and rapid tapping like a beat.
...It feels as if what is walking is not human feet, but two dry wooden sticks.
Soon, a wrinkled face poked out from the dark corridor.
But this time, before the other party could make any move, Zhou You rushed forward to greet him.
There was no panic or fear on his face, only a smile as warm as the sun.
"Hello, I am a new tenant. Are you the landlady?"
The old man, who was as dead as a tree, made no response.
It used its pale eyes to look at Zhou You for a long time, but still couldn't see clearly, so it raised its hand and held its own face.
Then, the man suddenly took out an eyeball, put it into his stained clothes, and wiped it carefully.
A fat maggot poked out from between the eye sockets. It swayed its body as if it wanted to find some food, but was immediately pushed back by the 'landlady'.
Looking at this weird and horrifying scenery, Zhou You's smile was as bright as ever.
——The previous tenant wailed out the second message.
"Be polite."
After a long time, the 'landlady' seemed to have finally wiped the eyeballs clean, stuffed them in again, then opened her black mouth and said in a hoarse voice, like sawing wood.
"A new resident, right? Have you brought any money?"
Zhou You recalled the introduction at the beginning of the script and hurriedly groped around on his body for a while. As expected, he groped for a whole wad of money in his jacket pocket.
But before taking it out, he hesitated for a moment, then separated half of it without leaving any trace, and then handed over the rest.
A smile finally appeared on the old lady's face, and her withered mouth slowly opened——
This time it didn't expand, and there were no sharp teeth in it.
Yet someone still felt a lurch in his stomach.
